script_source:
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib
import json
import os
import subprocess
import numpy as np
import ml_dtypes
import tessera as ts
from tessera import runtime as rt

root = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
assert Path(ts.__file__).resolve().is_relative_to(root / 'python')
assert rt._rocm_live_arch() == rt._rocm_chip() == 'gfx1151'
source = 'def product(a, b):\n    return tessera.ops.matmul(a, b, output_dtype="fp32")\n'
rows, retained = [], []
for storage, dtype in [('fp16', np.float16), ('bf16', ml_dtypes.bfloat16)]:
    public = ts.from_text(source, target='rocm')
    prior = {}
    for iteration, shape in enumerate([(16, 32, 16), (17, 31, 19), (48, 33, 16), (16, 32, 16)]):
        m, k, n = shape
        rng = np.random.default_rng(9481151 + iteration)
        a = rng.uniform(-0.5, 0.5, (m, k)).astype(dtype)
        b = rng.uniform(-0.5, 0.5, (k, n)).astype(dtype)
        original_a, original_b = a.copy(), b.copy()
        a.flags.writeable = b.flags.writeable = False
        output = public(a, b)
        expected = a.astype(np.float32) @ b.astype(np.float32)
        np.testing.assert_allclose(output, expected, rtol=1e-4, atol=1e-3)
        np.testing.assert_array_equal(a, original_a)
        np.testing.assert_array_equal(b, original_b)
        assert public.execution_kind == 'native_gpu'
        assert public.compile_result.target == 'rocm_gfx1151'
        receipt = public._native_descriptor_last_receipt
        assert receipt['compiler_path'] == 'rocm_gfx1151_native_descriptor'
        bundle = public.compile_bundle
        assert 'schedule.matmul' in bundle.schedule.text
        assert 'tile.matmul_kernel' in bundle.tile.text
        assert 'tessera_rocm.wmma_gemm' in bundle.target_ir.text
        if shape in prior:
            assert public.compile_result is prior[shape]
        prior[shape] = public.compile_result
        retained.append((output, output.copy()))
        rows.append({'storage':storage,'shape_mkn':list(shape),'replayed_existing_shape':iteration == 3,
                     'correctness':'independent_f32_oracle_passed','max_abs_error':float(np.max(np.abs(output-expected))),
                     'execution_kind':public.execution_kind,'compiler_path':receipt['compiler_path'],
                     'image_digest':bundle.native_image.image_digest,
                     'schedule_sha256':hashlib.sha256(bundle.schedule.text.encode()).hexdigest(),
                     'tile_sha256':hashlib.sha256(bundle.tile.text.encode()).hexdigest(),
                     'target_sha256':hashlib.sha256(bundle.target_ir.text.encode()).hexdigest()})
        print(rows[-1], flush=True)
    assert len(public._native_descriptor_specializations) == 3
for actual, original in retained:
    np.testing.assert_array_equal(actual, original)
sha = lambda p: hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
paths = ['python/tessera/compiler/jit.py','python/tessera/compiler/driver.py','python/tessera/compiler/rocm_native.py','python/tessera/runtime.py','python/tessera/compiler/backend_manifest.py','python/tessera/compiler/capabilities.py','tests/unit/test_rocm_public_matmul.py']
packet = {'status':'exact_gfx1151_public_jit_execution','architecture':rt._rocm_live_arch(),
          'compiler_build_host':'Tajasaurus','execution_host':subprocess.check_output(['hostname'],text=True).strip(),
          'coordinating_revision_before_review':'6c1ab58885ada59645c0489a8d0fa5ce789fc2ef',
          'source_state':'working_tree_with_resolved_target_review_fix; exact hashes below',
          'source_sha256':{p:sha(root/p) for p in paths},
          'binary_sha256':{name:sha(Path(os.environ[name])) for name in ['TESSERA_OPT','TESSERA_ROCM_OPT']},
          'layout_library_sha256':sha(root/'libtessera_layout_algebra.so'),
          'gpu_report':subprocess.check_output(['/opt/rocm/bin/rocminfo'],text=True),
          'script_sha256':sha(Path(__file__)), 'script_source':Path(__file__).read_text(), 'fixture_log_sha256':sha(root/'public-jit-tests.log'), 'fixture_result':'8 passed, 40 skipped; isolated-marker warning', 'rows':rows,
          'cross_architecture_switch_scope':'Host-free regression probes both architecture-switch directions; this packet executes only the actual gfx1151 device.',
          'timing_claim':False}
(root/'public-jit.json').write_text(json.dumps(packet,indent=2)+'\n')
print('eight exact-device public calls passed; shape replay reuses each cached specialization', flush=True)
cross_architecture_switch_scope: Host-free regression probes both architecture-switch directions; this packet executes only the actual gfx1151 device.
